The Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM) Audit Events normalization schema reference | Microsoft Docs leads 2117 Defender updates

May 2026 recorded 33 new, 2059 updated, 22 removed Microsoft Defender documentation changes and 3 relevant Message Center announcements. The most active areas were Sentinel, Endpoint, Defender XDR.

  • Sentinel · Developer and API
    The Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM) Audit Events normalization schema reference | Microsoft Docs

    Added Microsoft Defender documentation in sentinel/normalization-schema-audit.md.

  • Exposure Management · Vulnerabilities and exposure
    Risk evaluation framework changelog

    Added Microsoft Defender documentation in exposure-management/risk-evaluation-changelog.md.

  • Endpoint · Vulnerabilities and exposure
    Migrating from non-Microsoft HIPS to attack surface reduction rules

    Updated Microsoft Defender documentation in defender-endpoint/migrating-asr-rules.md.

  • Defender XDR · Hunting and detection
    Advanced Hunting Security Copilot Threat Hunting Agent

    Updated Microsoft Defender documentation in defender-xdr/advanced-hunting-security-copilot-threat-hunting-agent.md.

Microsoft Defender for Office 365: ZAP expands cleanup to Deleted Items
